findings.text: get_rsdp_addr provides early boot lookup of the ACPI root pointer location, returning a physical address or zero when no source yields one.

Root pointer memory scanning advances by a fixed stride over the requested window, accepts only candidates with valid signature and checksums, applies the extended checksum solely to newer revisions, and reports absence when nothing passes.

BIOS discovery derives an address from the extended data area pointer, probes that window only above a low memory cutoff, then probes a high reserved window, returning the first validated pointer or zero.
Root pointer resolution prefers an address already present in boot parameters, then consults the EFI provided location, then performs BIOS memory search, propagating zero if all miss.

An optional command line override supplies the root pointer as bounded hexadecimal text; oversize input warns and is ignored, conversion failure yields zero, and without kexec support the override stays inactive with zero as default.
Compressed boot exposes helpers to fetch an option value into a caller buffer and to test a boolean option, both resolving the command line through a shared accessor.
The command line address combines two boot parameter fields, treating one as the low half and a shifted companion field as the high half of the full address.

Boot text to unsigned conversion tolerates a leading plus and one trailing newline, infers decimal octal or hexadecimal when no base is given, strips a hex prefix, rejects empty or trailing garbage, and separates overflow from invalid input with distinct negative results.

The narrower unsigned conversion reuses the wider conversion and fails when the value does not fit, while overflow prediction uses a small wide by narrow division helper that preserves remainders and handles large high halves.

Locality table discovery starts from the command line override or boot parameter pointer, selects between extended and classic root tables using an explicit request plus revision and address availability, rejects undersized headers, then scans entries for the locality signature.

Immovable accounting is skipped when firmware tables are disabled, otherwise it walks locality subtables, aborts collection on zero length entries, records only non hotpluggable ranges with nonzero extent, aborts on capacity exhaustion, and returns how many ranges were stored.
count_immovable_mem_regions returns how many immovable ranges were discovered and leaves their recorded start and extent pairs for later reservation logic.
Boot code exposes queries for individual processor capability bits, one shot capability collection, status word mutability testing, and direct processor identification reads.

Capability collection runs once per boot, sets the floating point bit from a hardware probe, and only when the identification flag is mutable reads vendor and family plus model and feature words from standard and extended leaves within validated ranges.
Floating point presence is inferred by clearing emulation and task switched controls, reinitializing the unit, and checking that observed status and control values match reset expectations.
Mutability of a requested status word bit is decided by sampling flags, attempting to flip the requested bit, and observing whether the change persists.
The firmware table header carries a wide signature followed by revision, header size, checksum and reserved fields in ascending order with fixed widths.
A firmware memory descriptor records type with padding, physical and virtual addresses, page count and attributes, and an accessor derives the nth entry by scaling an index with a runtime stride.
Configuration table entries pair a unique identifier with a table address whose width follows firmware bitness, with separate shapes for wide and narrow firmware.

System table images begin with the common header then vendor identity and revision, console and error handles and interfaces, runtime and boot service pointers, table count and table array location, with padding and pointer widths differing by firmware bitness.
The unaccepted memory tracker stores version, unit size, base and extent followed by a variable length bitmap for fine grained state.
Firmware memory classification uses seven for conventional and fifteen for unaccepted, separate high attribute bits for higher reliability and soft reservation, and a page shift of twelve.

Standard firmware identifiers exist for ACPI, second generation ACPI, confidential blob and unaccepted memory tables, plus short loader signatures distinguishing narrow and wide boot, with identifier storage aligned to four byte boundaries.
Soft reservation reports enabled only when build configuration and runtime state agree in one build variant, and reports disabled unconditionally in the alternate variant.
panic accepts a format and arguments, renders into a fixed temporary buffer, removes one trailing newline, and delegates display to the common error path.

startup_32 in the 32 bit image is the initial protected mode control point that establishes addressing, relocates the image for safe expansion, prepares stack and descriptors, and moves toward decompression.
startup_32 in the 64 bit capable image validates long mode support and builds identity paging before enabling paging and long mode and entering 64 bit code.

Early 32 bit startup moves from direction and interrupt suppression through runtime address discovery, descriptor installation and segment reload, output placement honoring alignment and minimum location, stack setup, backward image copy, descriptor refresh, and jump to the relocated copy.

The move to 64 bit mode sequences segment setup and control transfer, optional exception setup, processor validation, temporary placement choice, paging structures with optional encryption masking, control register and descriptor updates, and a far transfer into wide mode.
Locality parsing trusts firmware supplied addresses without mapping validation and treats malformed lengths or excessive region counts as fatal to collection, discarding partial results.
Early command line and numeric parsing assumes reachable boot parameter memory and bounded option text; overlong overrides are ignored with a warning rather than truncated.
The compressed command line unit retains a persistent segment related word and treats addresses as native unsigned words, while shared headers use include guards against multiple inclusion.
